pages.label: BERKELEY SHORE HOTEL
pages.title: Berkeley Shore Hotel – Miami Hotel & Resort
pages.text:
Berkeley Shore Hotel Miami Hotel Resort
Berkeley Shore Hotel
The Berkeley Shore Hotel is a 4-star hotel, conviniently located on the beach and only half a mile from Art Deco Historic District, in the renowned South Beach area. This prime location offers easy access to the vibrant atmosphere of Lincoln Road Mall, with its array of shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues, all within a 4-minute walk.
All guestrooms are equipped with modern amenities, including complimentary WiFi, a spacious 50-inch flat-screen TV, and a secure safety deposit box. For added convenience, guests can enjoy brewing their own coffee using the in-room coffeemaker. The hotel features the breathtaking rooftop pool and sundeck.
Conveniently located, the Miami International Airport is a mere 10 miles away from the property.
